inputs.name: specificationStorageReport.root
inputs.description: Repository root beneath which the function resolves specification/units and specification/budgets/ledger.ndjson. Only regular .json files found under the unit directory are counted; unreadable directories and failed file stats are treated as empty or zero, while a ledger stream error can reject the report.

outputs.name: specificationStorageReport
outputs.description: The report gives the number and total bytes of .json unit files, the ledger byte and line counts, the fixed operator heads-up thresholds, and any warnings. A warning appears when its byte total is at or above the corresponding threshold; filesystem enumeration and stat failures are treated as empty or zero.

warnings: Unit JSON store is at or above the 16777216-byte operator heads-up.
Budget ledger is at or above the 2097152-byte operator heads-up.

errors.name: Error
errors.description: A ledger stream error rejects the report while its lines are being counted. Directory enumeration and file stat errors are caught and treated as empty or zero.
